title: Café and restaurant twin data contract v1
description: Four tables a café or restaurant can export from its POS, rostering system and accounts. No customer names, phone numbers, emails or card numbers are needed, and no staff names; the importer ignores columns that look like personal information. Money is NZD; POS amounts include GST unless flagged. Independent assembl concept.

source_system.description: POS, rostering or accounting system name and version

txn_id.description: Receipt, order or docket number. Lines with the same txn_id are one transaction. Also recognised as: transaction_id, order_id, order_no, receipt, receipt_no, sale_id, check, check_no, docket.

opened_at.description: When the order was taken (local time). Drives the demand curve by hour. Also recognised as: opened, date_time, datetime, created_at, order_time, sale_time, timestamp, date, time_opened.

closed_at.description: When it was paid or completed. Also recognised as: closed, paid_at, time_closed, completed_at.

channel.description: Dine in, takeaway, delivery app (Uber Eats, DoorDash and similar) or online pickup. Delivery apps are recognised from the text. Also recognised as: order_type, sales_type, type, dining_option, source, mode.

table_id.description: Table number for dine-in. Also recognised as: table, table_no, table_number.

covers.description: Guests on the transaction (dine-in). Also recognised as: guests, pax, guest_count, people.

item_sku.description: PLU or product code. Also recognised as: sku, item_id, plu, product_id, product_code.

item_name.description: Menu item as sold. Also recognised as: item, product, product_name, description, menu_item, name_of_item.

qty.description: Units on the line. Also recognised as: quantity, units, count, qty_sold.

net.description: Line amount after discounts. Assumed to include GST unless net_includes_gst says otherwise. Also recognised as: net_sales, net_amount, amount, total, line_total, sales, value, gross.

net_includes_gst.description: true if net includes GST (the usual NZ POS report). Also recognised as: incl_gst, gst_inclusive, tax_inclusive.

unit_cost.description: Recipe or ingredient cost per unit, excl. GST, if the POS holds it. Enables menu engineering on your own items. Also recognised as: cost, item_cost, recipe_cost, cost_price.

staff_id.description: Payroll or staff number. No names needed. Also recognised as: employee_id, emp_id, staff_no, payroll_id, employee_number.

role.description: Barista, kitchen, floor, bar, dishes, manager. Also recognised as: position, area, department, team, job.

start.description: Shift start (rostered or clocked). Also recognised as: start_time, clock_in, shift_start, in, time_in.

end.description: Shift end. Also recognised as: end_time, clock_out, shift_end, out, time_out, finish.

break_minutes.description: Unpaid break minutes. Also recognised as: break, breaks, unpaid_break, break_mins.

rate.description: Hourly rate excl. on-costs. If missing, $27 an hour is assumed and labelled. Also recognised as: hourly_rate, pay_rate, wage, rate_per_hour.

invoice_date.description: Invoice date. Also recognised as: date, inv_date, document_date, issued.

supplier.description: Supplier name (a business, not a person). Also recognised as: vendor, supplier_name, from, contact.

category.description: Account or category. Rent, power, insurance and similar are excluded from cost of goods. Also recognised as: account, type, group, gl_account, expense_type.

amount_ex_gst.description: Invoice amount excl. GST. Also recognised as: amount, net, subtotal, total_ex_gst, excl_gst, amount_excl_gst, value.

date.description: Date logged. Also recognised as: logged, day, waste_date.

item.description: What was thrown away. Also recognised as: item_name, product, description.

qty.description: Units on the line. Also recognised as: quantity, units, portions.

kg.description: Weight, if weighed. Also recognised as: weight, weight_kg, kgs.

cost.description: Cost of what was thrown away, excl. GST. Also recognised as: value, cost_value, amount.

reason.description: For example: unsold at close, spoiled, plate waste. Also recognised as: why, cause, type.
